summary: Implemented all assigned frozen ABI declarations, constructors, methods, trait implementations, root module declarations, and convenient re-exports. Added 31 inline unit tests across the six owned Rust files.

implementation.lib: Unconditional no_std and alloc, feature-gated std import, all eleven canonical public modules, and explicit canonical type and trait re-exports.
implementation.span: Exact specified fields, representations, and derives; const construction and checked end arithmetic; checked conversion to usize and bounds-safe slicing.
implementation.buffer: Arc and Bytes payload ownership, private validation proof metadata, documented unsafe issuance and assembly contracts, immutable message accessors, owned value extraction, and checked raw/string resolution.
implementation.error: All 33 error codes and 13 error sources, const constructors, schema context attachment, allocation-free Display formatting, core::error::Error, and the canonical Result alias.
implementation.scan: Exact backend identifiers, C-layout carry and block masks, zeroed defaults, and the canonical ClassifyFn signature.
implementation.syntax: All tokens, scalar kinds, frame phases, events and scan steps; documented limit presets; default cursor and scratch storage; clear retains allocation capacity while removing all message state.

decisions_where_specification_did_not_de.permissive_limits: All numeric ceilings use their declared integer type maximum; both key rejection flags are false. Zero is a literal resource ceiling, not an unlimited sentinel.
decisions_where_specification_did_not_de.error_context_defaults: Error::new initializes schema_id and field_id to zero; with_schema replaces both identifiers.
decisions_where_specification_did_not_de.error_display: Source: Code at byte OFFSET (schema SCHEMA_ID, field FIELD_ID), followed by ': DETAIL' when detail is nonempty.
decisions_where_specification_did_not_de.payload_construction: from_slice copies into Arc<[u8]>; from_vec transfers ownership into bytes::Bytes.
decisions_where_specification_did_not_de.string_resolution: resolve_str selects the requested backing buffer and validates bounds and UTF-8. scalar_len remains metadata and does not truncate or index the returned string.
decisions_where_specification_did_not_de.proof_contract: Unsafe callers must establish schema validation, exact buffer lengths, valid references, UTF-8, and scalar counts, and preserve those invariants. Metadata alone does not prove validity.

coverage: Canonical root exports and Send/Sync bounds
Const span construction, u32 overflow, empty spans, bounds, and fixed layouts
Payload ownership, cheap clones, empty buffers, and proof accessors
Message accessors, value extraction, buffer selection, UTF-8 boundaries, and invalid spans
Error context, display formatting, all code/source variants, and core error integration
Scanner defaults, carry preservation, high-bit masks, backend tags, and classifier function compatibility
Exact limit presets, cursor defaults, event data, enum distinctions, and scratch capacity reuse

verification.method: Source review only; no executable validation was performed.
verification.reason: The task explicitly prohibits compiler, build, formatting, and check commands.

integration_notes: The six sibling ABI modules number, node, schema, endpoint, wire, and traits are declared and re-exported as required, but their implementations are outside this task's file ownership. Their files were absent at initial inspection.

Compilation, feature compatibility, and unit test results remain unverified until the authorized integration phase.
